---
title: "Email Feed"
description: "Opening paragraphs only. This feed exists so Buttondown can build the subscriber email; readers want /index.xml."
listing:
  id: email-posts
  type: table
  contents: post
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [date, title]
  feed:
    # The point of this third feed. `partial` puts only each post's first
    # paragraph in the entry, so the subscriber email is an opening plus a link
    # rather than the whole post. Emailing the full text would send puzzler
    # solutions unfolded -- the fold is CSS, which mail clients do not load --
    # along with equations as CodeCogs images and figures as SVGs that some
    # clients will not render.
    #
    # /index.xml stays `full` for feed readers and /r-feed.xml stays `full`
    # because R-bloggers requires it. Nothing here replaces either.
    type: partial
    items: 20
  page-size: 50
toc: false
comments: false
# Unlisted, like r-feed.qmd: nothing links here, so keep it out of site search.
search: false
---

This feed carries the opening paragraph of each post, and exists so that [Buttondown](https://buttondown.com/) can build the email sent to subscribers. If you are reading feeds directly you want the [main feed](/index.xml), which carries every post in full, or the [R feed](/r-feed.xml).
